subject: General Knowledge
description: Major Indian airports, sea ports, railway firsts

questions.stem: Indira Gandhi International Airport serves which city?
questions.explanation: IGIA — Palam, New Delhi — busiest airport in India. Mumbai — Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International. Bengaluru — Kempegowda International. Kolkata — Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International. Chennai — Anna International.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Match the AIRPORT NAME with its CITY. A. Rajiv Gandhi International Airport.  B. Biju Patnaik International Airport.  C. Lokpriya Gopinath Bordoloi International Airport.  D. Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Airport. List-II: 1. Hyderabad.  2. Bhubaneswar.  3. Guwahati.  4. Ahmedabad.
questions.explanation: Hyderabad — Rajiv Gandhi (Shamshabad). Bhubaneswar — Biju Patnaik. Guwahati — Lokpriya Gopinath Bordoloi. Ahmedabad — Sardar Patel. (Bordoloi was Assam's first CM, nicknamed 'Lokpriya' — 'loved by the people'.)
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Which is the LARGEST natural harbour on the western coast of India?
questions.explanation: Mumbai Port (at the Mumbai harbour of the Konkan coast) — India's largest natural harbour on the west coast. JNPT (Nhava Sheva) is also on the same harbour and handles most of Mumbai's container traffic. Kandla (now Deendayal Port) is a tidal port. formerly Bombay.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: India's FIRST passenger train ran between:
questions.explanation: 16 April 1853 — India's first passenger train ran 34 km from Bori Bunder (Mumbai) to Thane. Three locomotives — Sahib, Sindh, Sultan — pulled 14 carriages carrying ~400 passengers. Howrah-Hooghly in eastern India followed in 1854. 34 km, 1853.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The LONGEST railway platform in the world is at:
questions.explanation: Siddharoodha Swami Ji Maharaj Hubballi railway station holds the world record (inaugurated 2023) at ~1,507 m. Previous record holder was Gorakhpur (~1,366 m). Kharagpur (1,072 m) was earlier record-holder. (Facts may shift as records change — a staleness watchpoint.)
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Jawaharlal Nehru Port (JNPT / Nhava Sheva) is located in which state?
questions.explanation: JNPT — on the eastern shore of Mumbai harbour, Raigad district, Maharashtra. Commissioned 1989. India's busiest container port; handles >50% of containerised cargo across major Indian ports.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The ONLY TIDAL port of India is:
questions.explanation: Kandla (Gujarat, Gulf of Kutch) — India's first port on the west coast after partition (1950s). Designed as a tidal port. Renamed Deendayal Port (2017). Chief exports: salt, cotton, oil, agricultural produce. Kolkata is a RIVERINE port on the Hooghly. now Deendayal Port.
